name: item
title: Item
description: Flush row: title and description on the left, meta on the right.
docs: Raster leaves are StyleX. Compile them with @stylexjs/babel-plugin (Vite: @stylexjs/unplugin, Next: @stylexjs/nextjs-plugin). If you would rather not run a compiler, import @noorddev/raster-react instead: it ships precompiled with one stylesheet.

raster.snippet:
Alkmaar

The studio city.

NL
raster.example:
import { Item } from "@noorddev/raster-react";

<Item title="Alkmaar" description="The studio city." meta="NL" />

use: Rows in a flush list: a title, a line of description, a trailing meta value.
avoid: Rows that navigate; wrap the title in a Link.
Tabular numbers across many columns; use Table.
